name: Anika Sharma
title: Finally a protein that tastes like juice
review: I could never finish a milky protein shake — it always felt heavy and left me bloated for hours. This is the complete opposite. It is clear, light, and honestly tastes like a chilled mango juice. I keep two bottles in the fridge and have one right after my workout. 24g of protein and zero sugar, and I actually look forward to drinking it. Delhi summer plus this cold is unbeatable.

name: Rohan Kapoor
title: Zero bloating, no chalky aftertaste
review: Bought the mango orange 3-pack to try and ended up ordering the 12-pack the same week. It mixes completely clear, no clumps, no thick milky texture sitting in your stomach. I train in the evening and used to skip my shake because it made me too full for dinner. Now I finish the bottle on the drive home and still eat properly. Digests really easy.

name: Meera Pillai
title: Refreshing post-workout, not a dessert
review: Most protein drinks taste like liquid sweets by the third sip. This one stays refreshing all the way down — more like a sports drink or a juice than a shake. The electrolytes are a nice touch after a sweaty session. Only reason for 4 stars is that I wish there were more flavours beyond mango orange, but the taste itself is genuinely good.

name: Divya Nair
title: Perfect for anyone lactose sensitive
review: Whey concentrate always upset my stomach, so I mostly gave up on protein supplements. Clear whey isolate has been a completely different experience — light, no gas, no heaviness. I have the powder in the morning and keep a bottle in my gym bag for later. Hitting my protein target has stopped being a chore. The mango flavour is not artificial at all.

name: Sanya Khanna
title: The 20 scoop tub is great value
review: Started with the bottles and switched to the tub for daily use. One scoop in cold water, shake for a few seconds and it goes completely clear — no foam, no lumps stuck at the bottom. 15g protein with 3g BCAA and zero sugar fits my cut perfectly. I drink it through the day at my desk like a juice rather than forcing it down post-workout.

name: Ishita Roy
title: My daily hydration plus protein
review: Tastes like a fruit drink, digests like water, and gets my protein in. Replaced my shake completely.

name: Tanvi Mehta
title: Travel-friendly protein
review: Carried four bottles on a work trip. No shaker, no mess, no milk to worry about. Grab, chill, drink.

name: Preethi Subramanian
title: Actually light on the stomach
review: Zero carbs and zero bloat. I can drink it right before a run and feel nothing sitting in my gut.

name: Arjun Qureshi
title: Second order already
review: Ordered the 3-pack to test, went straight to 24. Mango orange is dangerously easy to drink.

name: Nidhi Gupta
title: Great in the heat
review: Chilled after a hot walk it is genuinely refreshing. The electrolytes help more than I expected.

name: Aarohi Jain
title: Tastes like real mango
review: Crisp, fruity, not sugary. Hard to believe there is 24g of protein in it.

name: Kritika Bose
title: Even my non-gym husband drinks it
review: Bought it for myself, now we both finish a bottle a day. It just tastes like juice.

name: Karan Ahluwalia
title: Mixes perfectly clear
review: No clumps, no foam, no residue at the bottom. Ten seconds of shaking and it is done.

name: Kavya Reddy
title: Clear whey done right
review: Light, fruity, and zero sugar. Exactly what I wanted from a protein drink.

name: Simran Batra
title: Reaching for it every single day
review: Keeping it stocked in the fridge now. That says everything.
